quiz.subject: Anglais

answers.correction: 'In front of', 'Behind', and 'Next to' are all common English expressions used to describe location in relation to other objects or landmarks.
'In front of' is indeed an expression used to describe location in relation to something else, such as 'The car is parked in front of the house.'
'Behind' is a common English expression used to describe location behind something, such as 'The tree is behind the house.'
'Next to' is indeed an expression used to describe location in relation to something else, such as 'The book is next to the lamp.'
